correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT is quantified over real l_infty^n, n>=2 and finite t>=1. The 2023 primary Proposition 4.4 (verified in its full article) restricts optimizing y to sign vertices. Isometric signed coordinate permutations put x=(1,a2,...), with a2=s2. For each vertex one of the chord norms is 2 and the other at most 1+a2; choose opposite signs at first two coordinates to attain (2,1+a2). Monotonicity of M_t yields exact equality. Range/equality loci follow strictly from s2∈[0,1]. Restriction t>=1 and finite dimension essential; no t<1 claim made.
